name: pixel art item icon, dark mode
prompt: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.

item_descriptions: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. a syringe-shaped specimen collector, tilted diagonally from lower left to upper right, medium slim proportions: the body is about six times longer than it is wide, about 13 pixels wide. A glass cylinder fully enclosed in a polished blue-steel metal frame: solid metal rails run along both long sides of the cylinder and metal collars at both ends, the glass is seen through a long window between the rails, small tick marks on the frame. A flared metal cap at the top with a small round ring loop. At the bottom a short, blunt, stepped metal nozzle, cylindrical and rounded at the tip, not a needle, not pointed. All metal parts are always the same plain cool blue-steel grey, never gold or yellow, the color and light belong only to the liquid. The glass cylinder is empty and transparent: you see the dim inside through clear glass with thin white reflection lines, not filled with white, nothing inside. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
